summary: Preserved M108 results are internally consistent and independently recounted. Dataset GT provenance, source/label/bank/archive hashes, checkpoint frozen tensors and original bank preservation pass. Both arms fail a fixed promotion gate; reviewed text has no positive same-weight mean-IoU increment. Claims remain limited to this single-seed cached Train-state experiment.
trace_writer: Parent executor retains the request/response and call metadata. Reviewer write authorization was limited to these two reports.

gt_provenance.details: All 152 saved dataset GT arrays match the source specification hashes. All 3,502 current/previous event labels match the arrays, and the 3,039 valid output keys/strata match the labels. IoU is dataset-box localization supervision. The 152 text descriptions and 11 used A/B choices are explicitly unconfirmed model judgments, not human or physical-identity GT. All four private review input hashes, CSV-to-label values, initial CSV ID/sequence/split mapping, candidate JSON mapping and both bank bindings were verified.
limits: Candidate feature tensors and source image contents were not inspected; no direct boxes-to-IoU replay was executed.

Initial dataset bbox is intentionally used to initialize/crop the tracker. The excluded GT is current/future target coordinates in model inputs; GT does guide offline event/stratum sampling and training targets.
Semantic correctness and first-frame observability of the model review were not independently certified.

score_normalization.details: Metric denominators are geometric union for IoU or numbers of evaluated states. Threshold counts use IoU >= 0.5. Oracle is a separate maximum-IoU candidate upper bound, never a denominator. Model masked means and reliable-native loss average over support counts, not a prediction-derived accuracy scale.

result_existence.details: Independently parsed and recounted all eight JSONL files, matched all per-stratum result summaries and same-weight comparisons, verified all seven zero exit files and launch/history/log/result consistency. Source/parent/bank/label/final hashes match recorded values. Compressed archive SHA/size match the mirror and all 32 members are byte-identical to local files. Its 30-entry manifest excludes its own file and controller.log; the archive comparison covers both.
limits: This establishes consistency of preserved artifacts, not a fresh witness of the original GPU process or an independent rerun.
Final checkpoints contain model state, not optimizer state. Twelve epoch records support the reported 480 updates; no per-update optimizer trace was supplied.

dead_code_and_dataflow.details: The active M108 evaluate/summarize functions are called for fit and all three development conditions. Gradients propagate through the frozen selection MLP to the permitted semantic inputs. CPU Torch inspection strictly loaded both 56-entry final states, confirmed all 35 frozen parameter tensors (146,311 elements) and both buffers (56 elements) are bitwise equal to M101, and found only permitted-prefix changes (18 of 19 trainable tensors; 95,683 trainable elements). All nine original M107 bank fields are preserved exactly. Empty development selections/IoUs match M101 in all 495 rows for both arms.
limits: No model forward, backward, optimizer update, CLIP encoding, or GPU job was executed by this reviewer.

Exact before/after Empty scores and quality across all 3,039 states, finite gradients, and the historical save/load roundtrip are source assertions supported by successful GPU logs/results. Their raw score arrays are not stored for an independent equality replay.
Phrase support/conflict/visibility meanings have no independent labels; the three output channels are not calibrated semantic evidence.

scope.details: One seed (2027), two fixed-final arms, 130 fit sequences/2,544 valid states and 22 disjoint Train development sequences/495 states; 10 cached candidates/state. GT-dependent event selection produces overlapping healthy/intermediate/late-low/transition strata. These are selected Train-state diagnostics, not all-frame or official benchmark metrics. Development evidence also motivated M108 after M107, so it is not an untouched final test set. Both own-condition joint gates fail and every reviewed-text same-weight mean-IoU comparison is negative.
limits: No multiple-seed robustness, statistical significance, recursive recovery, identity accuracy, human evaluation, or DepthTrack Test/CDTB/VOT improvement is established.
Generic input preserves the per-sequence reviewed phrase masks; it is a mask-matched nonempty control, not a label-metadata-free condition.
No repository-wide or historical audit of all other benchmark result files was performed.

personally_executed: Read all supplied active source files and result/exit/log files; read the subsequently supplied M108_RESULT_NOTE.md.

Independent standard-library recount from all 8 JSONL files (8,058 stored rows): 2 x 2,544 fit plus 6 x 495 development. Used independent math.fsum aggregation, 1e-12 summary tolerance, exact counts/key/set comparisons.
Recomputed all four fixed gates for each own-condition final and every reported same-weight content comparison.
Verified disjoint fit/development sequence sets, source GT event keys/strata, parent development selections and the two identical Empty development row files.
Read and hashed all 152 local GT arrays (219,993 rows); checked all 3,502 current/previous event labels against their source arrays and source-spec hashes.
Verified private reviewed CSV values and binding mappings without publishing raw private label contents.
Loaded existing CPU Torch 2.14.0+cpu without installing software; compared final tensors to M101 and all original M107 bank fields to M108; strict model state loading only.

Verified archive compressed bytes and all 32 member bytes, all 30 manifest hashes, recorded source/checkpoint/bank/label hashes, preparation log, launch ordering, seven exits and every epoch log/result history.
not_executed: No SSH or network access, GPU job, installation, source/result modification, feature extraction, model forward/backward, optimizer update or CLIP text encoding.
No recursive tracker run, official evaluator, semantic-label re-annotation, human review or raw image/video inspection.
No reconstruction of all 3,039 full Empty score/quality arrays, because they are not serialized in the supplied results and feature caches were not inspected.

action_items: Preserve and report this negative result with both failed gate components. Do not infer a semantic gain from improvements over the native candidate alone.
Keep 130/22 Train sequences, selected cached states, one seed, model-weak labels, matched masks and lack of official/recursive evaluation explicit.
Distinguish direct CPU tensor/JSONL/GT checks from historical GPU assertion evidence whenever stating full3039 score/quality preservation. No rerun is needed merely to report this negative result.
Preserve the exact CSV and JSON label-binding paths with the receipts; initial_binding_sha256 references the CSV. Any future human-confirmed labels must be separately versioned.
Treat M108_RESULT_NOTE.md:70 as scoped to this runner: M108 performed no official benchmark evaluation. Global immutability of other benchmark artifacts was not part of this audit.
